a genuine v2 marker.means: This server produced the document and its bytes have not changed since. It does not prove who the signer is, and it is not a qualified electronic signature.

a v2 marker over changed content.checked: the document bytes and the assertion fields
a v2 marker over changed content.means: The document or its signature block changed after this server signed it, or it was signed by a server holding a different key.
